name: When should I engage a closing coordinator for my luxury home sale?

mainEntity.name: When should I engage a closing coordinator for my luxury home sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should engage a closing coordinator as soon as your luxury home goes under contract. This allows for immediate integration into the sales process, ensuring a smooth transition from contract acceptance to closing. Early engagement helps the coordinator proactively identify potential issues, such as appraisal complexities or specific title requirements for unique luxury properties, and establish clear communication channels with all involved parties from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engage a closing coordinator as soon as your luxury home is under contract to ensure immediate integration and proactive management of the complex sales process.
